Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
These two vote cards say to divide X/4 among two or more methuselahs.
Can I therefore assign 4 blood loss to one and 0 to another for
example? Or must it be at least 1 to each of two or more methuselahs?

T

Messages.Author: wes
Messages.Body:
<Talo...@hotmail.com> wrote

> These two vote cards say to divide X/4 among two or more methuselahs.
> Can I therefore assign 4 blood loss to one and 0 to another for
> example? Or must it be at least 1 to each of two or more methuselahs?

No, it must be 2 or more Methuselahs. Had it been written 'Divide X among 1
or more Methuselahs' it would be as you say (and much more powerful). As it
is, you have to either assign at least one point of damage from the vote to
someone else... depending on who has the votes or if there are only two
players left, this might even be yourself.

Another slightly ambiguous card, Rumors of Gehenna says you can assign its
effect to a 'set of Methuselahs'. You have the perogative of defining the
size of that set, be it just yourself, two players not including yourself,
every player in the game, etc.

Cheers,
WES
